title: Minecentral
description: A resource-sharing platform with an Express/MongoDB REST API for uploading resources and images, browsing creations, and downloading community content.

title: BetterRTP - Plugin
description: A Java plugin that brings random teleportation to Minecraft servers through the Spigot API. Built with Maven and published on SpigotMC.

title: Arlington Food Shelf
description: A food shelf application connecting inventory management with online shopping and customer orders, built with Express and a SQL database.

title: Employee Tracker
description: A command-line application for managing employee records in a relational PostgreSQL database using Node.js.

title: Weather App
description: A weather dashboard that turns OpenWeatherMap API data into a city-based forecast interface.

title: Movie Mania
description: A movie search application that lets visitors explore titles through a dedicated search interface.
